active.title: Southbound marsh birds
active.what: Check marshes and bay edges for changing flocks; migration varies with weather
active.caution: Calls or sightings do not independently prove the timing of a migratory movement
active.source: Existing Michigan Phenology fall migration calendar

active.title: Changing leaves & woodland phenophases
active.what: Watch different tree species move from colored leaves to leaf drop; report actual dates from a known tree
active.caution: A statewide maple report cannot confirm leaf color in a particular town
active.source: Existing Michigan Phenology calendar and USA-NPN leaf observations

active.title: First frosts & the autumn garden
active.what: Compare overnight minima, skies and actual observed frost before deciding what to protect
active.caution: Weather suitability is not an observed frost event

active.title: Lake smoke and freeze-up clues
active.what: Compare lake-to-air temperature contrast, cold-air outbreaks and shore exposure
active.caution: Cold air alone does not confirm lake smoke or safe ice

upcoming.title: Spring salamander movements
upcoming.what: Look for managed education walks and compare thaw, rain and temperature
upcoming.caution: Suitable weather is not a confirmed migration or a publicly accessible crossing

upcoming.title: Frog and toad chorus
upcoming.what: Listen for different calls near permitted wetland edges on mild evenings
upcoming.caution: Weather ratings do not verify calls or animal abundance

upcoming.title: Woodcock sky dance
upcoming.what: Check published viewing opportunities and listen at dusk from permitted ground
upcoming.caution: Seasonal timing is not a recorded display at a particular site

upcoming.title: Michigan flowering destinations
upcoming.what: Check dated venue reports before traveling for blossoms or seasonal displays
upcoming.caution: Published display schedules do not confirm flowers open today

upcoming.title: Large-flowered trillium
upcoming.scope: Broad spring calendar; reported-flowering history is regional
upcoming.what: Look for buds and open flowers in permitted woodland places and record the stage
upcoming.caution: Historical report weeks do not establish first bloom at a preserve
upcoming.source: Existing Trillium Tracker and independently tested reporting archive

upcoming.title: Ruby-throated hummingbirds
upcoming.what: Prepare a clean feeder before the usual first-report window and watch for actual arrivals
upcoming.caution: First public reports are not confirmed first biological arrivals
upcoming.source: Existing Hummingbird Tracker and independently tested reporting archive
